defect: The wip change dropped the enable_temp_file_encryption gate so large temp buffers are encrypted whenever full_encryption is set; the fix restores the gate only on the write-side encryption call.
reason: Both flags are set together in practice and the change kept write and read paths consistent, while the fix's partial restore (delta and read path still keyed on full_encryption) looks like WIP churn; the actual test repair lies in encryption_functions.cpp.

defect: The fix deletes the by-then unused HandleStructPack helper and corrects binding lookups in RewriteExpressions and RemoveColumnsFromLogicalGet, code written by later commits.
reason: The only overlap with this change is removing dead code; the repaired lookup logic was authored months later by other commits.

defect: The fix renames the cgroup path constants to upper case (code style).
reason: Pure style rename; the fix's hunk changes no behaviour.

defect: RemoveColumn's STANDARD case lacks a break and falls through into the default branch, throwing NotImplementedException after removing a standard column.
reason: The fall-through is in lines this change added and the fix adds the missing break alongside formatting.

defect: The fix ports the benchmark from the Appender(DuckDB&, ...) constructor to Connection::OpenAppender after a master merge changed the Appender API.
reason: The code matched the Appender API that existed at the change; it broke only because of an API change elsewhere.

defect: The fix avoids integer overflow of source.count * target.count in Combine by multiplying doubles; this change only reformatted that line.
reason: The overflow predates this formatter-only change.

defect: The fix removes the assert against selection vectors in WriteInsert because DataChunk::Serialize now honours selection vectors for strings.
reason: The real repair is in data_chunk.cpp; dropping the assert enables a case callers produced later, not a defect of this change.

defect: The fix updates TableFunction::Equal from with_ordinality to ordinality_data after a later commit renamed the member.
reason: with_ordinality existed in the header at this change; the rename came in a later commit.

defect: The fix removes the illegal extra qualification ordinality_data_t:: on the in-class SetOrdinality and adds comparison operators.
reason: The extra qualification already existed before this change, which only altered the signature; the operators are new functionality for the fix's own Equal change.

defect: Value::BIGINT(limit.offset_val + limit.limit_val) overflows int64 (undefined behaviour) when limit_val is NumericLimits<int64_t>::Maximum(), e.g. OFFSET without LIMIT in a correlated subquery.
reason: The overflowing addition was added by this change and the fix replaces it with a saturating TryAddOperator; seeing it needs knowing the binder sets limit_val to the maximum.

defect: The fix sets the filtered payload cardinality in SinkDistinct, guards payload_chunk initialisation and remaps child reference indexes in FinalizeDistinct.
reason: All repaired lines come from later WIP commits (56f7b80, 8c01dbd, 47dd665); the expression index mismatch was already noted as a TODO and present before this change.

defect: D_ASSERT(value >= 0) after the wrapping unsigned subtraction value - min_delta fails for valid inputs whose delta range exceeds INT64_MAX, aborting debug builds.
reason: The assert was added here next to a comment that overflow wraps; the fix replaces it with min_delta <= value checked before the subtraction.

defect: The DUCKDB_NO_THREADS ConcurrentQueue uses std::queue without a template argument and calls nonexistent enqueue/dequeue methods, so the no-threads build does not compile.
reason: The broken fallback is entirely in lines this change added and the fix uses std::queue<unique_ptr<Task>> with push, front and pop.

defect: TransformStringToLogicalType(str, context) resolves a user type only when the top-level parsed type is USER and looks it up by the raw string, so nested user types such as JSON[] or STRUCT(a JSON) stay unresolved.
reason: The fix rewrites this function added by the change to recurse into LIST, STRUCT and MAP and to look the type up by its name.

defect: GetJoinSide returns NONE for a column bound to neither child, so conditions referencing tables outside the join are classified as one-sided and pushed too deep.
reason: The NONE return replaced an assert in this change; the fix returns BOTH for that case to stop the wrong pushdown.

defect: The fix adds more TPC-DS query numbers to the compile-regression list.
reason: Test list update only.

defect: The fix replaces TYPEOF comparisons with R's IS_* macros throughout DetectRType, touching the blob lines only mechanically.
reason: The integer-date crash is unrelated to the blob detection this change added, whose lines are only rewritten in style.

defect: SchemaInSearchPath compares schema and catalog names case-sensitively, so SHOW TABLES misses entries whose names differ only in case.
reason: The function was added by this change while the rest of the file uses CIEquals, and the fix switches it to case-insensitive comparisons.

defect: The fix adds the missing '=' in the Windows GetWorkingDirectory buffer declaration.
reason: The missing '=' was already present before this change, which only renamed make_array to make_unsafe_array on that line.

defect: The fix moves ColumnFetchState from the shared index-scan global state into the thread-local state to remove a data race.
reason: The shared fetch_state predates this nits change, which only moved the declaration.

defect: The fix renames JEMallocExtension to JemallocExtension after the extension class was renamed.
reason: At this change the class was JEMallocExtension with ThreadFlush(idx_t), so the code was correct then.

defect: Commit buffers inserted tuples and writes them to the WAL only at the end, after UPDATE/DELETE queries that are written immediately, so replay runs those queries before the rows exist; inserts modified later in the same transaction hit assert(0).
reason: The fix flushes pending appends before each query and handles the modified-insert case, both in code this change added.

defect: PreferCaseMatching penalises case mismatches also for catalog, schema, table and column names, changing suggestion ranking and breaking an autocomplete test.
reason: The list was introduced by this change and the same-day fix trims it to restore the expected suggestions; seeing it needs the test expectations.

defect: The ingest loop calls get_next into the same ArrowArray before appending and never releases the previous array, leaking every batch.
reason: The get_next placement was added here and the leak-fix commit moves it after the array is destroyed and reallocated.

defect: String::operator< never uses the character comparison (the loop only breaks) and returns this_size < other_size, and can read one past the shorter string.
reason: The fix compares characters and returns at the first difference in the operator this change added.

defect: The fix wraps a long condition line (formatting).
reason: Formatting only.

defect: The fix renames INPUT to input for clang-tidy naming rules.
reason: Style only.

defect: The fix reverts the include reordering made by this change.
reason: Include order only; no behaviour or compile defect is involved.

defect: The fix adds an explicit optional_idx include and drops an unused, undefined CGroupBandwidthQuota declaration.
reason: optional_idx was already included through file_system.hpp and the dead declaration caused no failure, so this is include hygiene.

defect: MergeFunctionSet appends the existing functions to the by-value parameter new_functions, which is discarded, so new overloads are never merged into the set.
reason: The inverted loop is in the function this change added and the fix pushes the new functions into this->functions.

defect: The fix renames the constructor parameters and moves them (tidy shadowing and performance).
reason: Style; the parameters were the same before this formatting change.

defect: The fix makes arrow_scan_init return an empty FunctionOperatorData instead of nullptr.
reason: At this change PhysicalTableScan accepted a null operator state; a later rework of table-function init made nullptr mean nothing to scan.

defect: Clearing finalize_partitions only when a Scan task completes misses the case where the last event is the finalize of an empty partition, so a later re-scan can spin; the fix moves the clear into AssignTask and adds locks.
reason: The fix moves the line this change added, but the change was itself a partial fix of a multi-scan bug that was already broken before, and the concrete failure the fix targets is not evident.

defect: The fix adds update locks to StandardColumnData Update and AppendData to remove a data race.
reason: This change only threaded a row_group_start parameter through; the race predates it.

defect: The fix adds braces around an if body (tidy).
reason: Style only.

defect: The fix reformats the new Create and CreateRel declarations.
reason: Formatting only.

defect: RadixBitsOfPowerOfTwo returns the bit length (log2(n)+1) instead of log2(n), an off-by-one against the loop it replaced.
reason: The fix subtracts one in the function this change rewrote.

defect: The fix raises MANAGED_BUFFER_QUEUE_SIZE from 1 to 6.
reason: Tuning of the queue count; the renamed constants kept the previous value 1.

defect: The fix re-implements the test helper compare_result, which this change stubbed out with a FIXME throw.
reason: A deliberate test-infrastructure placeholder restored by a test change.

defect: The fix stops marking the result constant for volatile C API functions with more than one input row.
reason: When this change was made C API scalar functions were always consistent; duckdb_scalar_function_set_volatile came later (fbb7535), which is where the constant-result assumption broke.
